Subject: Post-sign transition: Steering to Success & initial implementation asks

Hi Emily / Ravi —

Thanks again for signing — thrilled to get Crestline Health onboarded. I wanted to kick off the formal handoff thread and surface the immediate asks so CS can pick up confidently. Attached are: the signed SOW, a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP), and our implementation runbook stub.

Quick summary / asks from Sales (me):
- Kickoff target: Mon Jun 26 or Tue Jun 27 — please advise preferred date/time.
- Primary goals for first 30 days: SSO + IdP test account, ingestion of 2 sample datasets, and one internal admin training session.
- Security: Crestline security requested SOC2 evidence — we provided the security packet in the drive link.

Internal owner suggestions (please confirm):
- Primary CS lead: Tessa Morgan (Tessa will own onboarding and customer success plan)
- Secondary technical lead: Priyom Das (integration, SSO, data ingestion)

Karthik — can you confirm the internal SLA on handoff artifacts (runbook update, billing handoff notes)?

Emily — once you confirm the kickoff window and who from your IT/security should join, we’ll schedule and send an agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: DL-2028-0784_SOW_Crestline.pdf, DL-2028-0784_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, implementation_runbook_v1.md

Thanks Marissa — excited to get started. Jun 26 works best for our team; morning PST preferred (9–11am).

A couple of items from our side:
- Please include our IT security lead, Nora Lim (nora.lim@crestlinehealth.com) on the invite — she’ll validate SSO and compliance expectations.
- For data ingestion, we’ll bring a masked sample dataset and a tech contact (Ravi will coordinate).
- Can you share a short pre-kickoff checklist so we can prepare (config items, sample formats, test accounts)?

Appreciate the clarity on owners — Tessa and Priyom noted. Looking forward to the kickoff invite.

Best,

Marissa — thanks for the handoff. A couple internal notes and confirmations: 
- Handoff artifacts required from Sales: final signed SOW (done), MAP (please confirm any updates post-sign), list of expected SLAs (latency/throughput expectations), and any bespoke feature flags.
- Triage: Tessa will be primary CS owner for the 0–30 day plan; Priyom will lead technical onboarding for SSO and ingestion.
- Billing: Marissa, please flag if there were any billing concessions/credits to carry to Finance.

Subject: Re: Post-sign transition: Steering to Success & initial implementation asks

Thanks — I’ll own the kickoff and the 30/60/90 success plan. Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (5 min)
- Objectives & acceptance criteria (5 min)
- Security & compliance overview (10 min)
- SSO/IdP test plan + required artifacts (10 min)
- Data ingestion plan + sample formats (5 min)
- Next steps & owners (5 min)

Pre-kickoff checklist (to be sent as a short doc):
- Confirm attendee list and technical leads (IdP admin + integration engineer)
- Provide a masked sample dataset (CSV/JSON) and schema
- Create an IdP test account or provide SSO metadata (SAML/OIDC)
- Review the MAP and acceptance criteria

I’ll create a calendar invite for Mon Jun 26, 10:00am PST and include the prep checklist and runbook link. Priyom — can you confirm availability for that slot?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com

I’m available for Mon Jun 26, 10am PST. Quick technical asks I’ll need pre-kickoff to prepare the SSO test:
- IdP metadata (SAML) or OIDC discovery URL
- Test user account credentials (non-prod) or assertion for validation
- Network allowlist IPs (if applicable)

Marissa — were there any custom data retention requirements agreed to in the SOW? That will affect our ingestion pipeline config and default retention settings.

— Priyom

Thanks everyone — Tessa will lead the kickoff. Tessa / Priyom, please move the updated runbook to the shared drive and ping Karthik once the MAP has been finalized.
